shapeSummary: Stadium-shaped (round-end) flat aluminum plate, 56 mm long (X) by 32 mm wide (Z) by 2.5 mm thick (Y, bottom at Y=0). It has two 14 mm through holes at X=±12 mm. The end radius is 16 mm.
warnings: Dimensions come from unverified listing specs.
The two 14 mm hole centers at X=±12 mm are inferred from the 24 mm across-center spacing, not printed on the part.
About 14 smaller pattern holes (some slotted) are visible, but their diameters and positions are not given, so they are omitted.
The plate lies in the XZ plane, with thickness along Y from 0 to 2.5 mm.
cadquery:
base = cq.Workplane('XY').slot2D(56, 32).extrude(2.5)
holes = cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(-12, 0), (12, 0)]).circle(7).extrude(2.5)
plate = base.cut(holes)
part = plate.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), -90)
